commit_subject: fidelity gate: record WHEN it may be deleted — not at activation, and a reroll voids it

[installer] Add JDK 22-26 across all 9 vendors, fix the hang-prone JDK download and a wrong macOS extraction path, and drop RISC-V: installer_config.py gains verified URLs for every vendor/version combo that actually ships a build (graal-jdk-26, mandrel-jdk-26, and microsoft-jdk-22/23/24/26 are intentionally absent rather than None, since none of those upstream builds exist); tornadovm-installer now generates its JDK menu and --jdk validation from those constants instead of a hand-maintained list that had already drifted out of sync (rotated vendor descriptions, JDK-21-only version detection, and a make target hardcoded to jdk21 regardless of the JDK actually selected); JDK downloads move from the wget PyPI package, which hangs indefinitely with no timeout on GitHub's redirect-to-signed-URL release asset chain, to requests with a real connect/read timeout and progress reporting; Zulu's macOS java_home path is fixed (its tarball does wrap Contents/Home like every vendor except Liberica, confirmed by inspecting the real archives, not the reputation it was previously grouped under); and Makefile gains the mvn-single-threaded-jdk22plus target this makes reachable for the first time. Both the jdk21 and jdk22plus build paths were validated with real, complete installer runs (zulu-jdk-21, graal-jdk-25) through to a working SDK, not just unit tests.
